_rule: Never delete or reword a task (id, title, done_when); new tasks may be added. Only status and evidence change. status: todo -> in_progress when work on it starts -> done only when every part of done_when is met, including any sign-off it names (passing tests alone do not close a task that also needs the user's approval) -> blocked when it cannot move, with the reason in evidence. evidence: what proves the status, e.g. the command run and its result, a file path, a date.
